# Mnemo

> Mnemo is a free, open-source, local-first learning platform for desktop
> (Windows, macOS, Linux). It brings notes, flashcards with spaced repetition,
> mind maps, and learning paths together in one app. There are no accounts, no
> ads, no tracking, and no cloud requirement: all data stays on the user's
> machine. Licensed Apache-2.0.

Key facts:

- Price: free, no paid tier, no subscription
- License: Apache-2.0, source available at https://github.com/onemnemo/mnemo
- Privacy: offline first, no account, no telemetry, data stored locally
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux (desktop app)
- Method: built on spaced repetition and active recall research

## Pages

- [Home](https://mnemo.one/): overview of the app and its features
- [Download](https://mnemo.one/download): installers for all platforms
- [Why it works](https://mnemo.one/science): the memory science behind the app
- [Docs](https://mnemo.one/docs): installation and usage documentation
